BIM = BIM or {} local M = BIM -- Debug logging to the board console / game log (grep the log for "[BIM]"). -- Toggle off with the `debug` export. -- NOTE: in DU, injected globals (system, unit, slot1..slot10) must be referenced -- directly by name, not through the global table -- so we do that everywhere below. local function dbg(msg) if M.debug == false then return end if system and system.print then system.print("[BIM] " .. tostring(msg)) end end local function round1(n) return math.floor(n * 10 + 0.5) / 10 end function M.formatVolume(liters) liters = liters or 0 if liters < 1000 then return string.format("%d L", math.floor(liters + 0.5)) end if liters < 1000000 then return string.format("%s kL", round1(liters / 1000)) end if liters < 1000000000 then return string.format("%s ML", round1(liters / 1000000)) end return string.format("%s GL", round1(liters / 1000000000)) end function M.formatMass(kg) return string.format("%.1f t", (kg or 0) / 1000) end function M.formatPct(pct) pct = pct or 0 if pct < 0 then pct = 0 elseif pct > 100 then pct = 100 end return string.format("%d%%", math.floor(pct + 0.5)) end local MAX_SLOTS = 10 -- a Programming Board exposes slot1..slot10 -- Best-effort in-game name of a linked element handle (Element.getName()). local function handleName(c, idx) local label = nil pcall(function() label = c.getName() end) if label == nil or label == "" then label = "Container " .. tostring(idx) else label = label:gsub("%s*%[%d+%]%s*$", "") -- strip the " [457]" element-id suffix end return label end -- Build a label from a container's actual contents. -- content: array of {id, quantity} (from getContent()). getItem(id) -> item table. -- Returns nil when there is nothing to name from (so callers can fall back to the -- element's own name). Uniform tier is prefixed ("T1 ..."); up to maxShown item -- names are listed by quantity, with "+N" for the remainder. function M.itemLabel(content, getItem, maxShown) if not content or #content == 0 or not getItem then return nil end maxShown = maxShown or 2 local qty, order = {}, {} for _, e in ipairs(content) do local id = e.id or e[1] local q = e.quantity or e[2] or 0 if id and id ~= 0 then if not qty[id] then qty[id] = 0; order[#order + 1] = id end qty[id] = qty[id] + q end end if #order == 0 then return nil end local items = {} for _, id in ipairs(order) do local it = getItem(id) local name = it and (it.locDisplayName or it.displayName or it.name) or ("#" .. tostring(id)) items[#items + 1] = { name = name, tier = it and it.tier, q = qty[id] } end table.sort(items, function(a, b) return a.q > b.q end) local utier = items[1].tier for _, it in ipairs(items) do if it.tier ~= utier then utier = nil; break end end local shown = {} for i = 1, math.min(maxShown, #items) do shown[#shown + 1] = items[i].name end local label = table.concat(shown, ", ") if #items > maxShown then label = label .. " +" .. (#items - maxShown) end if utier then label = "T" .. tostring(utier) .. " " .. label end return label end -- Curated DU ore database (all 19 raw ores) so ore is detected precisely -- the one -- ambiguous case, since ores, pures and products all report type="material". local ORE_SET = { quartz = true, hematite = true, coal = true, bauxite = true, limestone = true, natron = true, malachite = true, chromite = true, garnierite = true, petalite = true, pyrite = true, acanthite = true, cryolite = true, cobaltite = true, kolbeckite = true, columbite = true, rhodonite = true, ilmenite = true, vanadinite = true, } -- DU's item `type` is coarse (object / material / worldMaterial); materials are -- sub-classified into the friendly category Ore / Pure / Fuel / Scrap / Product. function M.classifyItem(it) if not it then return "Item" end local t = it.type if t == "object" then return "Objects" end if t == "worldMaterial" then return "Honeycomb" end local n = (it.locDisplayName or it.displayName or it.name or ""):lower() if ORE_SET[n] then return "Ore" end if n:match("^pure ") then return "Pure" end if n:match("scrap") then return "Scrap" end if n:match("fuel") or n:match("nitron") or n:match("kergon") or n:match("xeron") then return "Fuel" end return "Product" -- refined materials, alloys, plastics, glass, components, ... end -- Fine categories roll up into broad groups for mixed containers. local BROAD = { Ore = "Materials", Pure = "Materials", Product = "Materials", Fuel = "Materials", Scrap = "Materials" } -- Build a CATEGORY label from contents. A focused container shows its fine category -- ("T1 Ore"); two categories are listed ("T1-2 Ore & Pure"); a mixed container -- collapses to broad groups ("T1-3 Objects & Materials"). Returns nil if empty. function M.categoryLabel(content, getItem) if not content or #content == 0 or not getItem then return nil end local qF, oF, qB, oB, minT, maxT = {}, {}, {}, {}, nil, nil for _, e in ipairs(content) do local id = e.id or e[1] local q = e.quantity or e[2] or 0 if id and id ~= 0 then local it = getItem(id) if it then local fine = M.classifyItem(it) local broad = BROAD[fine] or fine if not qF[fine] then qF[fine] = 0; oF[#oF + 1] = fine end qF[fine] = qF[fine] + q if not qB[broad] then qB[broad] = 0; oB[#oB + 1] = broad end qB[broad] = qB[broad] + q local tr = it.tier if tr and tr > 0 then -- ignore tier 0 (gases) in the range if not minT or tr < minT then minT = tr end if not maxT or tr > maxT then maxT = tr end end end end end if #oF == 0 then return nil end -- few fine categories -> list them; many -> collapse to broad groups local keys, qty = oF, qF if #oF > 2 then keys, qty = oB, qB end table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return qty[a] > qty[b] end) local shown = {} for i = 1, math.min(2, #keys) do shown[#shown + 1] = keys[i] end local tierStr = "" if minT then tierStr = (minT == maxT) and ("T" .. minT .. " ") or ("T" .. minT .. "-" .. maxT .. " ") end local label = tierStr .. table.concat(shown, " & ") if #keys > 2 then label = label .. " +" .. (#keys - 2) end return label end -- Read one linked container/hub handle into a row record. -- opts: { getItem = fn(id)->item, labelMode = "auto"|"category"|"items"|"name" } local function readContainer(c, idx, opts) opts = opts or {} local mode = opts.labelMode or "auto" -- Request a content sync each render (updateContent is throttled to 1/30s -- internally, so calling more often is harmless and keeps it fresh). local wait if c.updateContent then pcall(function() wait = c.updateContent() end) end local label, stacks = nil, 0 if mode ~= "name" then -- Prefer content pushed by the onContentUpdate event; else poll getContent(). local content = M._content and M._content[c] or nil if content == nil then pcall(function() content = c.getContent() end) end stacks = content and #content or 0 if mode == "category" then label = M.categoryLabel(content, opts.getItem) elseif mode == "items" then label = M.itemLabel(content, opts.getItem) else -- auto: category, then item names, then the element's own name label = M.categoryLabel(content, opts.getItem) or M.itemLabel(content, opts.getItem) end end local nm = handleName(c, idx) if not label then label = nm end -- name mode / fallback if (M._tick or 0) <= 6 then dbg(string.format("box '%s': %d stacks, updWait=%s -> '%s'", nm, stacks, tostring(wait), label)) end local vol = c.getItemsVolume() local maxVol = c.getMaxVolume() local mass = c.getItemsMass() local pct = 0 if maxVol and maxVol > 0 then pct = (vol / maxVol) * 100 end return { label = label, vol = vol or 0, maxVol = maxVol or 0, mass = mass or 0, pct = pct, ok = true } end -- Build rows from an array of container/hub handles (already filtered). -- opts forwarded to readContainer. A failed read becomes ok=false. function M.buildRows(containers, opts) local rows = {} for i = 1, #containers do local c = containers[i] if c ~= nil then local ok, row = pcall(readContainer, c, i, opts) if ok then rows[#rows + 1] = row else rows[#rows + 1] = { label = handleName(c, i), vol = 0, maxVol = 0, mass = 0, pct = 0, ok = false } end end end return rows end -- Classify an array of linked slot handles into a screen + container list. -- Each handle exposes getClass(); screens match "Screen", containers/hubs match "Container". function M.classify(slots) local screen, containers = nil, {} for i = 1, #slots do local s = slots[i] if s ~= nil then local cls = nil pcall(function() cls = s.getClass() end) cls = cls or "" if (not screen) and cls:find("Screen", 1, true) then screen = s elseif cls:find("Container", 1, true) then containers[#containers + 1] = s end end end return { screen = screen, containers = containers } end function M.sortRows(rows, mode) if mode == "none" then return rows end local cmp if mode == "fill-asc" then cmp = function(a, b) return a.pct < b.pct end elseif mode == "name" then cmp = function(a, b) return tostring(a.label) < tostring(b.label) end else -- "fill-desc" default cmp = function(a, b) return a.pct > b.pct end end table.sort(rows, cmp) return rows end function M.aggregate(rows) local totalVol, totalMax, count = 0, 0, 0 for _, r in ipairs(rows) do if r.ok then totalVol = totalVol + (r.vol or 0) totalMax = totalMax + (r.maxVol or 0) count = count + 1 end end local pct = 0 if totalMax > 0 then pct = math.floor((totalVol / totalMax) * 100 + 0.5) end return { totalVol = totalVol, totalMax = totalMax, pct = pct, count = count } end function M.classifyLevel(pct, warnPct, critPct) if pct >= critPct then return "crit" elseif pct >= warnPct then return "warn" else return "ok" end end local function esc(s) s = tostring(s or "") s = s:gsub("&", "&"):gsub("<", "<"):gsub(">", ">") return s end -- Bar color per level. local LEVEL_COLOR = { ok = "#00f3ff", warn = "#fffb00", crit = "#ff007f" } local function renderRow(M, r, warnPct, critPct) if not r.ok then return string.format( '

%s
' .. '
' .. '
%s / %s' .. '%s%s
', level, esc(r.label), pctInt, color, color, color, M.formatVolume(r.vol), M.formatVolume(r.maxVol), M.formatMass(r.mass), M.formatPct(r.pct)) end local CSS = [[ ]] function M.renderHTML(model) local parts = {} parts[#parts+1] = '

SYNC #%d  •  build %s
', model.tick or 0, esc(model.build or "dev")) parts[#parts+1] = '' return table.concat(parts) end -- ===== Screen render-script path (setHTML is deprecated on DU screens) ===== -- Encode the model as a tab/newline string fed to the render script via setScriptInput. -- Header line: title \t build \t aggPct \t count \t warnPct \t critPct \t tick -- Row lines: label \t pct \t volStr \t maxStr \t massStr local function san(s) return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("[\t\n]", " ")) end function M.buildScreenData(model) local lines = {} lines[1] = table.concat({ san(model.title), san(model.build or "dev"), tostring(math.floor((model.agg.pct or 0) + 0.5)), tostring(model.agg.count or 0), tostring(model.warnPct or 75), tostring(model.critPct or 90), tostring(model.tick or 0), }, "\t") for _, r in ipairs(model.rows) do if r.ok then lines[#lines + 1] = table.concat({ san(r.label), tostring(math.floor((r.pct or 0) + 0.5)), M.formatVolume(r.vol), M.formatVolume(r.maxVol), M.formatMass(r.mass), }, "\t") else lines[#lines + 1] = table.concat({ san(r.label), "0", "OFFLINE", "", "" }, "\t") end end return table.concat(lines, "\n") end -- The render script that runs ON the screen. M.RENDER_SCRIPT = [==[ local rx, ry = getResolution() local bg = createLayer() local fg = createLayer() local fTitle = loadFont('Play-Bold', math.floor(ry * 0.080)) local fRow = loadFont('Play', math.floor(ry * 0.042)) local fStat = loadFont('RobotoMono', math.floor(ry * 0.034)) local function col(l, r, g, b, a) setNextFillColor(l, r/255, g/255, b/255, a or 1) end col(bg, 13, 2, 17, 1); addBox(bg, 0, 0, rx, ry) local input = getInput() or '' local hdr, rows = nil, {} for line in (input .. '\n'):gmatch('(.-)\n') do if line ~= '' then local f = {} for fld in (line .. '\t'):gmatch('(.-)\t') do f[#f + 1] = fld end if not hdr then hdr = f else rows[#rows + 1] = f end end end local pad = rx * 0.04 if not hdr then col(fg, 255, 0, 127, 1); setNextTextAlign(fg, AlignH_Center, AlignV_Middle) addText(fg, fTitle, 'BASE INVENTORY -- no data', rx / 2, ry / 2) else local title = hdr[1] or 'BASE INVENTORY' local build = hdr[2] or '' local aggPct = tonumber(hdr[3]) or 0 local count = hdr[4] or '0' local warnPct = tonumber(hdr[5]) or 75 local critPct = tonumber(hdr[6]) or 90 local tick = hdr[7] or '0' local padX = rx * 0.045 -- Title (subtle glow) + sub-line. setNextShadow(fg, ry * 0.007, 0, 243/255, 1, 0.55) col(fg, 0, 243, 255, 1); setNextTextAlign(fg, AlignH_Left, AlignV_Top) addText(fg, fTitle, title, padX, ry * 0.045) col(fg, 177, 13, 201, 1); setNextTextAlign(fg, AlignH_Right, AlignV_Top) addText(fg, fRow, count .. ' CONT ' .. aggPct .. '%', rx - padX, ry * 0.06) -- Rows: full-width bars with the label + stats drawn OVER the bar. local top = ry * 0.22 local bottom = ry * 0.95 local n = #rows if n < 1 then n = 1 end local slotH = (bottom - top) / n local barH = slotH * 0.84 if barH > ry * 0.085 then barH = ry * 0.085 end local barX, barW = padX, rx - 2 * padX local inset = barH * 0.4 for i = 1, #rows do local r = rows[i] local label = r[1] or '' local pct = tonumber(r[2]) or 0 local volS, maxS, massS = r[3] or '', r[4] or '', r[5] or '' local y = top + (i - 1) * slotH local cy = y + barH / 2 local rad = barH * 0.22 -- empty track col(fg, 255, 255, 255, 0.06) addBoxRounded(fg, barX, y, barW, barH, rad) -- translucent fill (acts as the text background) local cr, cg, cb = 0, 243, 255 if pct >= critPct then cr, cg, cb = 255, 0, 127 elseif pct >= warnPct then cr, cg, cb = 255, 251, 0 end local w = barW * math.min(pct, 100) / 100 if w > rad * 2 then setNextFillColor(fg, cr/255, cg/255, cb/255, 0.5) addBoxRounded(fg, barX, y, w, barH, rad) end -- label over the bar (left), white with a dark outline for contrast setNextShadow(fg, ry * 0.004, 0, 0, 0, 0.95) col(fg, 255, 255, 255, 1); setNextTextAlign(fg, AlignH_Left, AlignV_Middle) addText(fg, fRow, label, barX + inset, cy) -- stats over the bar (right) setNextShadow(fg, ry * 0.004, 0, 0, 0, 0.95) col(fg, 255, 255, 255, 1); setNextTextAlign(fg, AlignH_Right, AlignV_Middle) addText(fg, fStat, pct .. '% ' .. volS .. ' / ' .. maxS .. ' ' .. massS, barX + barW - inset, cy) end col(fg, 110, 70, 140, 1); setNextTextAlign(fg, AlignH_Right, AlignV_Bottom) addText(fg, fStat, 'SYNC #' .. tick .. ' build ' .. build, rx - padX, ry - ry * 0.015) end ]==] -- Config comes from explicit options (passed to start), never from globals -- -- DU's global table does not carry our values reliably. local function buildConfig(opts) opts = opts or {} local debug = opts.debug if debug == nil then debug = true end local hud = opts.hud if hud == nil then hud = false end return { refreshSeconds = opts.refreshSeconds or 5, warnPct = opts.warnPct or 75, critPct = opts.critPct or 90, sortMode = opts.sortMode or "fill-desc", title = opts.title or "BASE INVENTORY", labelMode = opts.labelMode or "auto", debug = debug, hud = hud, build = opts.build or "dev", } end -- The board's link slots are DIRECT globals (slot1..slot10) referenced by name. -- Undefined ones read as nil (no error). local function rawSlots() local t = {} t[1] = slot1; t[2] = slot2; t[3] = slot3; t[4] = slot4; t[5] = slot5 t[6] = slot6; t[7] = slot7; t[8] = slot8; t[9] = slot9; t[10] = slot10 return t end -- Container onContentUpdate event handler (one per slot). DU pushes the freshly -- synced item list here; we cache it keyed by the element handle so the renderer -- uses it instead of polling. Logs every event to prove whether content arrives. function M.onContentUpdate(n) local s = rawSlots()[n] if not s then return end local content = nil pcall(function() content = s.getContent() end) M._content = M._content or {} M._content[s] = content or {} local cls = "?" pcall(function() cls = tostring(s.getClass()) end) dbg(string.format("CONTENT EVENT slot%d class=%s: %d stacks", n, cls, content and #content or 0)) end -- Dense array of linked slots (nil/unlinked dropped) so # is reliable. local function gatherSlots() local raw = rawSlots() local slots = {} for i = 1, MAX_SLOTS do if raw[i] ~= nil then slots[#slots + 1] = raw[i] end end return slots end -- Build the current run environment by scanning + classifying the slots. local function env() local sc = M.classify(gatherSlots()) return { screen = sc.screen, containers = sc.containers, config = M.config, tick = M._tick } end -- Print the class + name reported by every linked slot (diagnostics). local function dumpSlots() local raw = rawSlots() for i = 1, MAX_SLOTS do local s = raw[i] if s ~= nil then local cls, nm = "?", "?" pcall(function() cls = tostring(s.getClass()) end) pcall(function() nm = tostring(s.getName()) end) dbg(string.format("slot%d: class=%s name=%s", i, cls, nm)) end end end function M.start(opts) M.config = buildConfig(opts) M.debug = M.config.debug M._tick = 0 M._content = M._content or {} dbg("===== Base Inventory Monitor build " .. tostring(M.config.build) .. " =====") dbg("onStart begin -- scanning slot1.." .. MAX_SLOTS) dumpSlots() local e = env() dbg(string.format("detected: screen=%s containers=%d", e.screen and "OK" or "MISSING", #e.containers)) if e.screen then if e.screen.activate then pcall(function() e.screen.activate() end) end if e.screen.setRenderScript then pcall(function() e.screen.setRenderScript(M.RENDER_SCRIPT) end) dbg("screen.setRenderScript() installed") end end if M.config.hud and system and system.showScreen then pcall(function() system.showScreen(1) end) dbg("system.showScreen(1) called (HUD mirror)") end local data = M.run(e) dbg("run -> data len=" .. (data and #data or "nil")) if unit and unit.setTimer then unit.setTimer("refresh", M.config.refreshSeconds) dbg("timer 'refresh' set to " .. tostring(M.config.refreshSeconds) .. "s") end dbg("onStart done") end function M.tick() M.config = M.config or buildConfig() M._tick = (M._tick or 0) + 1 local data = M.run(env()) dbg("tick #" .. M._tick .. " -> data len=" .. (data and #data or "nil")) end function M.run(e) local cfg = e.config or {} local title = cfg.title or "BASE INVENTORY" local warnPct = cfg.warnPct or 75 local critPct = cfg.critPct or 90 local containers = e.containers or {} -- Cached system.getItem (items are static) for content-based labels. M._itemCache = M._itemCache or {} local cache = M._itemCache local function getItem(id) local v = cache[id] if v == nil then local it = nil if system and system.getItem then pcall(function() it = system.getItem(id) end) end cache[id] = it or false v = cache[id] if it then dbg(string.format("item id=%s name=%s type=%s tier=%s", tostring(id), tostring(it.locDisplayName or it.displayName or it.name), tostring(it.type), tostring(it.tier))) end end if v == false then return nil end return v end local rows = M.buildRows(containers, { getItem = getItem, labelMode = cfg.labelMode }) M.sortRows(rows, cfg.sortMode or "fill-desc") local agg = M.aggregate(rows) local model = { title = title, warnPct = warnPct, critPct = critPct, tick = e.tick or 0, rows = rows, agg = agg, build = cfg.build, } -- Screen: feed data to the render script (setHTML is deprecated on DU screens). local data = M.buildScreenData(model) if e.screen and e.screen.setScriptInput then pcall(function() e.screen.setScriptInput(data) end) end -- HUD mirror (HTML) -- optional, off by default (it covers the whole view). if cfg.hud and system and system.setScreen then pcall(function() system.setScreen(M.renderHTML(model)) end) end return data end BIM.start({ refreshSeconds = refreshSeconds, warnPct = warnPct, critPct = critPct, sortMode = sortMode, title = title, labelMode = labelMode, debug = bimDebug, hud = bimHud, build = '11 (08:55:51)' })
